lines.en: Joan Calamezzo claims there is a mistake in my book,
and so now she's trying to get me on a tiny technicality.
So just in case there is a mistake, which there is not,
I need all of you fact-checking every single detail.
Jerry, I need you to hit the road
and re-interview everyone who lives out of town.
The rest of you, call me as soon as you find
the mistake that does not exist.
Do you think there's actually a mistake in here?
If there's one thing Leslie's not, it's sloppy.
In here, it says the Pawnee is great,
Let Tom know we haven't found anything.
Hey, I'm thinking about getting a new phone.
Do you guys like your phones?
I've never used a phone in my life.
I'm gonna get these two people,
that I've known for a long time,
to talk to me for five minutes.
All right, so we don't have to fact-check anymore,
but Leslie wants us to be on Ready Alert 1,
just in case something comes up.
Now I can get some real work done.
You know, I think I'm just gonna hang out here with you guys,
I will get my one minute of small talk, damn it.
And it will be casual, and it will be amicable.
Well, I've made a little progress.
I'm up to four seconds with April.
I was looking to get some new music,
and I was wondering if you could recommend anything.
Who's your favorite character on Sex and the City?
You're stranded on a desert island.
What is the one thing that you bring with you?
Oh, man, I am so tired.
I took a half shift at the hospital last night,
and I had this really weird patient.
I probably shouldn't talk about it.
It's one of the grossest things I've ever seen.
He got his hand stuck in a Pringles can,
and he tried to cut himself out.
What kind of blade did he use?
Three and a half inch serrated buckets of blood.
He passed out over his arm and slumped onto the floor.
Everyone in the universe loves a gross medical story.
And so when I finally cleaned up the vomit,
Ann was getting a little chummy.
When people get too chummy with me,
I like to call them by the wrong name
to let them know I don't really care about them.
